# DALgo

> DALgo is a database abstraction layer for Go and TypeScript. One interface covers records, queries, and transactions; adapters connect each database.

DALgo is [open-source](https://github.com/dal-go/dalgo). The Go module is the main implementation ([MIT license](https://github.com/dal-go/dalgo/blob/main/LICENSE)). The TypeScript package @dalgo/core is published on npm from [dalgo-js](https://github.com/dal-go/dalgo-js) ([MIT license](https://github.com/dal-go/dalgo-js/blob/main/LICENSE)). English pages are the default. Russian pages use the same paths under /ru/.

## English

- [Home](https://dalgo.io/): DALgo is a database abstraction layer for Go and TypeScript. One interface covers records, queries, and transactions; adapters connect each database.
- [Go](https://dalgo.io/go/): DALgo for Go provides typed keys, records, collections, and structured queries. Begin with the built-in in-memory adapter, then choose a database adapter.
- [TypeScript](https://dalgo.io/typescript/): @dalgo/core is the TypeScript implementation of DALgo: hierarchical keys, typed collections, structured queries, and writes that run inside a transaction.
- [Adapters](https://dalgo.io/adapters/): DALgo adapter matrix for Go and TypeScript: implementation status, documented limits, and the runtime each adapter documents for browser or server.
- [Articles](https://dalgo.io/articles/): Notes on DALgo for Go and TypeScript: what the shared record and transaction interface is for, and when a database driver should stay in charge.
- [DALgo FAQ](https://dalgo.io/faq/): DALgo FAQ: what the database abstraction layer is, whether it is an ORM, which databases it supports, transactions, in-memory tests, TypeScript and install.

- [Go](https://dalgo.io/ru/go/): DALgo для Go: типизированные ключи, записи, коллекции и структурированные запросы. Начните со встроенного адаптера в памяти и выберите адаптер базы.

- [Зачем DALgo](https://dalgo.io/ru/why/): Зачем DALgo: предметный код зависит от одного интерфейса, тесты могут использовать адаптер в памяти, а хуки, журнал и транзакции не привязаны к конкретной базе.
- [Коллекции](https://dalgo.io/ru/collections/): Типизированная коллекция DALgo возвращает значения типа T для обычных чтений и записей. Набор операций зависит от выбранного адаптера.
- [Интерфейсы](https://dalgo.io/ru/interfaces/): Каждый адаптер DALgo реализует dal.DB. Чтение идёт через ReadSession, изменение через ReadwriteSession, а транзакция — это замыкание над сессией.
- [Запросы](https://dalgo.io/ru/queries/): Запросы DALgo фильтруют, сортируют, ограничивают, проецируют, группируют и соединяют данные. Недоступная адаптеру возможность возвращает dal.ErrNotSupported.
- [Фильм](https://dalgo.io/ru/film/): Короткий фильм DALgo на русском: тот же код и другой адаптер. Видео с YouTube загружается только после нажатия кнопки воспроизведения.
- [DataTug](https://dalgo.io/ru/datatug/): DALgo — шов доступа к данным в разработке DataTug. DataTug помогает изучать схемы и запросы, а доступ к хранилищу идёт через интерфейс DALgo.
- [Технологии](https://dalgo.io/ru/about/tech-stack/): Как устроен DALgo: библиотеки Go и TypeScript с адаптерами баз данных, документация, собранная на Python, и размещение в Cloudflare Workers.

## Repositories

- [dalgo](https://github.com/dal-go/dalgo): Go module and the main DALgo implementation.
- [dalgo-js](https://github.com/dal-go/dalgo-js): TypeScript package @dalgo/core.
- [dalgo-http-adapters](https://github.com/dal-go/dalgo-http-adapters): Qualification matrix and catalog for DALgo TypeScript HTTP data adapters.
- [dalgo2memory](https://github.com/dal-go/dalgo/tree/main/adapters/dalgo2memory): In-memory adapter shipped in the core module — the default store for tests, examples, and local development. Runs most structured-query features end to end.
- [dalgo2fs](https://github.com/dal-go/dalgo/tree/main/adapters/dalgo2fs): Filesystem metadata exposed as DALgo records. Point reads only; structured queries, writes and transactions are not supported.
- [dalgo2sql](https://github.com/dal-go/dalgo2sql): Adapter for the standard database/sql — any compliant driver.
- [dalgo2sqlite](https://github.com/dal-go/dalgo2sqlite): SQLite-specific driver: schema, DDL, concurrency-aware operations on top of dalgo2sql.
- [dalgo2postgres](https://github.com/dal-go/dalgo2postgres): PostgreSQL-specific driver on top of dalgo2sql: forces the postgres dialect, introspects catalogs and applies Postgres DDL.
- [dalgo2mysql](https://github.com/dal-go/dalgo2mysql): MySQL-specific driver on top of dalgo2sql: schema introspection and MySQL DDL. CI runs the conformance suite against MySQL 8.
- [dalgo2ingitdb](https://github.com/ingitdb/dalgo2ingitdb): Adapter for inGitDB — a Git-native database with branchable, mergeable data. Reads and writes; a transaction can be committed to Git. Lives in the inGitDB organization.
- [dalgo2openvaultdb](https://github.com/dal-go/dalgo2openvaultdb): Adapter for OpenVaultDB through its ovdb serve HTTP API: reads and transactional writes.
- [dalgo2firestore](https://github.com/dal-go/dalgo2firestore): For Google Cloud Firestore — a globally distributed NoSQL document database.
- [dalgo2http](https://github.com/dal-go/dalgo2http): Declarative HTTP endpoints — JSON, plus named XML and CSV resources — exposed as DALgo collections. Read-only by design.

## Optional

- [Quick start](https://dalgo.io/quickstart/): Install DALgo and write a record. Go starts with the built-in in-memory adapter. The TypeScript example stores data in IndexedDB in the browser.
- [Why DALgo](https://dalgo.io/why/): Why DALgo: domain code stays on one interface, tests can use the in-memory adapter, and hooks, logging, and transactions do not depend on the database.
- [Typed collections](https://dalgo.io/collections/): A DALgo typed collection returns values as T for everyday reads and writes. Which operations run depends on the adapter behind the collection.
- [Interfaces](https://dalgo.io/interfaces/): Every DALgo adapter implements dal.DB. Reads use ReadSession, writes use ReadwriteSession, and a transaction is a closure around that session.
- [Queries](https://dalgo.io/queries/): DALgo queries filter, sort, limit, project, group, and join. Nested keys scope a collection. A feature the adapter lacks returns dal.ErrNotSupported.
- [Films](https://dalgo.io/film/): Two short DALgo films: a pitch for one Go interface across databases, and a walkthrough that swaps the adapter. Play loads the video from YouTube.
- [DataTug](https://dalgo.io/datatug/): DALgo is the data-access seam used while building DataTug. DataTug explores schemas and queries; storage access stays behind the DALgo interface.
- [Tech stack](https://dalgo.io/about/tech-stack/): How DALgo is built: Go and TypeScript libraries with database adapters, a Python-rendered documentation site, and Cloudflare Workers hosting.
- [Privacy](https://dalgo.io/privacy/): dalgo.io is a static documentation site with no accounts. This page explains Google Analytics, the regional consent choice, and how to change it.
- [TugQL](https://dalgo.io/tugql/): Go TugQL YAML serializes the core relational dal.StructuredQuery losslessly. Get the current JSON Schema and examples; learn SQL-like TugQL text at tugql.org.
- [TugQL examples](https://dalgo.io/tugql/examples/): Example TugQL documents: human-readable YAML for dal.StructuredQuery. Each file is checked against the published TugQL JSON Schema.

## English product copy

DALgo is a database abstraction layer for Go and TypeScript. Write your domain logic once against a single, well-tested interface — swap Postgres for Firestore, an in-memory store for a real one — without touching your business code. The Go module is the main implementation; the TypeScript package, @dalgo/core, is published on npm.

Storage-agnostic logic. Write business code against dal.DB. Decide later whether it lives in Postgres, Firestore, or a JSON file on disk. The walkthrough is Switching between PostgreSQL and Firestore in Go.

Less code, more readable. A common contract for keys, records, queries and transactions. Supported operations depend on the adapter.

Testable by construction. Swap a production driver for the built-in dalgo2memory adapter in tests. Need mocks instead? The generated mocks package ships in the core repo.

Hooks & logging, for free. Because every operation goes through one interface, observability and audit logging are a wrapper — not a refactor.

One end-to-end test suite. The shared conformance suite tests common behavior. See the adapter matrix for implementation limits and runtime requirements.

Transactions, the Go way. Read-only and read-write transactions are first-class. Pass a closure, get atomicity — without leaking driver-specific transaction types into your domain.

Install it from npm with npm install @dalgo/core. The package has no database SDK of its own and does not connect to a database by itself; an adapter does. Source: dal-go/dalgo-js. How it works and how it compares with Prisma, Drizzle, TypeORM and Kysely: Database abstraction layer for TypeScript: @dalgo/core.

TypeScript adapters live in dalgo-http-adapters. Browser-local, browser HTTP and trusted-server adapters have separate requirements. See the Go/TypeScript and runtime matrix for source status and limitations.

Every DALgo adapter — SQL, NoSQL, embedded, filesystem — implements the same dal.DB contract. Read operations live on ReadSession; mutating operations live on ReadwriteSession. Transactions are closures: pass a function, the driver gives you a session, your code never sees a driver-specific handle. A repository in front of that handle is Repository pattern in Go with a swappable storage backend.

DALgo ships a structured query builder for the common database reads: filters, ordering, LIMIT, column projection, GROUP BY / HAVING, aggregates like COUNT(*) and SUM, and inner / left equi-joins. Keys can model nested document paths such as countries/ireland/cities/dublin, and a parent key scopes a query to a nested collection.

DataTug helps developers explore database schemas, write and run queries, and understand their results. DALgo provides a data-access seam in DataTug’s development ecosystem. Read how DataTug’s development tools were built.

## Russian product copy

DALgo — слой абстракции баз данных для Go и TypeScript. Пишите логику предметной области один раз, против единого хорошо протестированного интерфейса, — и меняйте Postgres на Firestore, а хранилище в памяти на настоящее, не трогая бизнес-код. Модуль для Go — основная реализация; пакет для TypeScript, @dalgo/core, опубликован в npm.

Логика, не зависящая от хранилища. Пишите бизнес-код против dal.DB. Где он будет жить — в Postgres, Firestore или в JSON-файле на диске, — решите позже. Разбор перехода — в статье Switching between PostgreSQL and Firestore in Go (англ.).

Меньше кода, он читается лучше. Общий контракт для ключей, записей, запросов и транзакций. Поддерживаемые операции зависят от адаптера.

Тестируемость по построению. В тестах подставляйте вместо боевого драйвера встроенный адаптер dalgo2memory. Нужны моки? Сгенерированный пакет mocks входит в основной репозиторий.

Хуки и логирование — бесплатно. Поскольку каждая операция проходит через один интерфейс, наблюдаемость и аудит — это обёртка, а не рефакторинг.

Один набор сквозных тестов. Общий набор проверок проверяет общее поведение. Ограничения и среды выполнения указаны в таблице адаптеров.

Транзакции в духе Go. Транзакции только для чтения и для чтения и записи — полноправная часть интерфейса. Передайте замыкание — получите атомарность, не пропуская типы транзакций конкретных драйверов в предметный код.

Установите пакет из npm: npm install @dalgo/core. У пакета нет собственного SDK базы данных, и сам он к базе не подключается — это делает адаптер. Исходный код: dal-go/dalgo-js. Как это устроено и чем отличается от Prisma, Drizzle, TypeORM и Kysely (статья на английском): Database abstraction layer for TypeScript: @dalgo/core.

TypeScript-адаптеры находятся в dalgo-http-adapters. Локальные, HTTP-браузерные и серверные адаптеры имеют разные требования. Смотрите таблицу Go/TypeScript и сред выполнения.

Каждый адаптер DALgo — SQL, NoSQL, встраиваемый, файловый — реализует один и тот же контракт dal.DB. Операции чтения живут в ReadSession, операции изменения — в ReadwriteSession. Транзакции — это замыкания: вы передаёте функцию, драйвер даёт вам сессию, а ваш код никогда не видит дескриптор конкретного драйвера. Репозиторий поверх этого контракта — в статье Repository pattern in Go with a swappable storage backend (англ.).

DALgo включает построитель структурированных запросов для типичных чтений: фильтры, сортировка, LIMIT, выбор столбцов, GROUP BY / HAVING, агрегаты вроде COUNT(*) и SUM, а также внутренние и левые соединения по равенству. Ключи могут описывать вложенные пути документов, например countries/ireland/cities/dublin, а родительский ключ ограничивает запрос вложенной коллекцией.

DataTug помогает разработчикам изучать схемы баз данных, писать и запускать запросы и понимать их результаты. DALgo служит швом доступа к данным в среде разработки DataTug. Прочитайте, как создавались инструменты разработки DataTug (на английском).

## English FAQ

### What is DALgo?

DALgo is a database abstraction layer for Go applications. Its [README](https://github.com/dal-go/dalgo) describes one small, consistent API for records, queries, transactions, hooks and schema-aware key mapping, while the storage backend stays an implementation choice. A TypeScript implementation, `@dalgo/core`, lives in a separate repository. See [DALgo for Go](https://dalgo.io/go/).

### Is DALgo an ORM (object-relational mapper)?

DALgo is a database abstraction layer, not a full ORM. GORM's guide calls it an ORM library for Go; DALgo gives the same record calls on SQL and on other stores, such as memory and Firestore. The core module has a small `orm` package that maps collections and fields onto DALgo collection references and conditions. [DALgo vs GORM](https://dalgo.io/articles/dalgo-vs-gorm/) compares the two.

### Which databases does DALgo support?

The core module includes `dalgo2memory` (in memory) and `dalgo2fs` (filesystem). The README lists separate adapter modules for SQL engines through `dalgo2sql`, PostgreSQL, SQLite, MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, Firestore, Datastore, MongoDB, Redis, DynamoDB and more. Each adapter supports different operations; the [adapter matrix](https://dalgo.io/adapters/) lists them one by one.

### Is DALgo open-source, and under what licence?

Yes. The Go module is [dal-go/dalgo](https://github.com/dal-go/dalgo) under the [MIT License](https://github.com/dal-go/dalgo/blob/main/LICENSE). The TypeScript package `@dalgo/core` is [dal-go/dalgo-js](https://github.com/dal-go/dalgo-js), also under the [MIT License](https://github.com/dal-go/dalgo-js/blob/main/LICENSE).

### Does DALgo support transactions?

Yes. `RunReadonlyTransaction` runs a function with read access, and `RunReadwriteTransaction` runs one that can also write. With typed collections, reads take a read session and writes take a write session, so writes are only reachable inside `RunReadwriteTransaction`. See [Interfaces](https://dalgo.io/interfaces/).

### How do I test code without a real database?

Use `dalgo2memory`, the built-in in-memory adapter: `dalgo2memory.NewDB()` returns a database that runs the same record, query and transaction code. The README says it can run many structured query features end to end, which makes it a practical default for unit tests. The [Quick Start](https://dalgo.io/quickstart/) starts with it.

### What happens when an adapter does not support a feature?

The adapter returns `dal.ErrNotSupported`. DALgo does not try to hide every database difference; the error keeps the core API honest. The [adapter matrix](https://dalgo.io/adapters/) shows which operations each adapter supports.

### How do I install DALgo?

For Go, run `go get github.com/dal-go/dalgo`, then add the adapter module for your database. For TypeScript, run `pnpm add @dalgo/core`; the core package does not connect to a database by itself, so you add an adapter too. See the [Quick Start](https://dalgo.io/quickstart/).

### Is there a TypeScript version of DALgo?

Yes. [@dalgo/core](https://github.com/dal-go/dalgo-js) is the browser-neutral TypeScript implementation, with hierarchical keys, typed collections, structured queries, records, database sessions and transaction-only writes. Its first adapter is for Firestore and uses Firebase's modular Web SDK in the browser. See [DALgo for TypeScript](https://dalgo.io/typescript/), or [Database abstraction layer for TypeScript: @dalgo/core](https://dalgo.io/articles/typescript-database-abstraction/) for how it works and how it compares with Prisma, Drizzle, TypeORM and Kysely.

### Does DALgo work with Firestore?

Yes. In Go, the `dalgo2firestore` adapter connects DALgo to Cloud Firestore. [Firestore in Go: CRUD and transactions with DALgo](https://dalgo.io/articles/go-firestore-tutorial/) creates, reads, updates and deletes a document and runs a read-write transaction, and runs the same functions on the in-memory adapter in tests.

### Can I switch a Go service from PostgreSQL to Firestore without rewriting business code?

Yes, for the record operations both adapters implement. Write the domain against `dal.DB`, open `dalgo2postgres` or `dalgo2firestore` in `main`, and use `dalgo2memory` in tests. [Switching between PostgreSQL and Firestore in Go without rewriting business code](https://dalgo.io/articles/switch-postgres-to-firestore/) walks through a users repository, what stays the same, and what still differs (schema, joins, transactions).

### When should I not use DALgo?

DALgo earns its place when the same domain code must run against more than one store, including a test double. It is the wrong tool when the engine's own query language is the product. [When to use DALgo, and when not to](https://dalgo.io/articles/when-to-use-dalgo/) lists the cases.

### What is TugQL?

TugQL is a readable YAML format for DALgo structured queries. Its Go implementation is the `tugql` package in the main module, which serializes `dal.StructuredQuery`. See [TugQL](https://dalgo.io/tugql/).

### Who maintains DALgo?

DALgo is developed in the [dal-go](https://github.com/dal-go) GitHub organization by the DALgo contributors; [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/dal-go/dalgo/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) explains how to contribute. DALgo provides the data-access seam in DataTug's development ecosystem, and Sneat Go services also depend on the module. See [Technology behind DALgo](https://dalgo.io/about/tech-stack/).

## Russian FAQ

### Что такое DALgo?

DALgo — слой абстракции базы данных для приложений на Go. В [README](https://github.com/dal-go/dalgo) он описан как небольшой единый API для записей, запросов, транзакций, хуков и отображения ключей по схеме, а хранилище остаётся деталью реализации. Реализация на TypeScript, `@dalgo/core`, живёт в отдельном репозитории. Подробнее: [DALgo для Go](https://dalgo.io/ru/go/).

### DALgo — это ORM?

DALgo — слой абстракции базы данных, а не полноценная ORM. Руководство GORM называет его ORM-библиотекой для Go; DALgo даёт одни и те же вызовы для записей в SQL и в других хранилищах, например в памяти и в Firestore. В основном модуле есть небольшой пакет `orm`, который связывает коллекции и поля со ссылками на коллекции и условиями DALgo. Сравнение — в статье [DALgo vs GORM](https://dalgo.io/articles/dalgo-vs-gorm/) (англ.).

### Какие базы данных поддерживает DALgo?

В основной модуль входят `dalgo2memory` (в памяти) и `dalgo2fs` (файловая система). README перечисляет отдельные модули адаптеров: SQL-движки через `dalgo2sql`, PostgreSQL, SQLite, MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, Firestore, Datastore, MongoDB, Redis, DynamoDB и другие. Адаптеры поддерживают разные операции; [таблица адаптеров](https://dalgo.io/ru/adapters/) показывает их по отдельности.

### DALgo — открытый исходный код? Какая лицензия?

Да. Модуль Go — [dal-go/dalgo](https://github.com/dal-go/dalgo) под [лицензией MIT](https://github.com/dal-go/dalgo/blob/main/LICENSE). Пакет TypeScript `@dalgo/core` — [dal-go/dalgo-js](https://github.com/dal-go/dalgo-js), тоже под [лицензией MIT](https://github.com/dal-go/dalgo-js/blob/main/LICENSE).

### Поддерживает ли DALgo транзакции?

Да. `RunReadonlyTransaction` выполняет функцию с доступом на чтение, а `RunReadwriteTransaction` — с доступом и на запись. В типизированных коллекциях чтение принимает сессию чтения, а запись — сессию записи, поэтому записать можно только внутри `RunReadwriteTransaction`. Подробнее: [Интерфейсы](https://dalgo.io/ru/interfaces/).

### Как тестировать код без настоящей базы данных?

Используйте `dalgo2memory`, встроенный адаптер в памяти: `dalgo2memory.NewDB()` возвращает базу, на которой работает тот же код записей, запросов и транзакций. По README он выполняет многие возможности структурированных запросов целиком, поэтому подходит по умолчанию для модульных тестов. [Быстрый старт](https://dalgo.io/ru/quickstart/) начинается с него.

### Что будет, если адаптер не поддерживает возможность?

Адаптер вернёт `dal.ErrNotSupported`. DALgo не пытается скрыть все различия баз данных; эта ошибка сохраняет основной API честным. [Таблица адаптеров](https://dalgo.io/ru/adapters/) показывает, какие операции поддерживает каждый адаптер.

### Как установить DALgo?

Для Go выполните `go get github.com/dal-go/dalgo` и добавьте модуль адаптера для своей базы данных. Для TypeScript выполните `pnpm add @dalgo/core`; сам пакет к базе не подключается, поэтому нужен ещё адаптер. Подробнее: [Быстрый старт](https://dalgo.io/ru/quickstart/).

### Есть ли версия DALgo для TypeScript?

Да. [@dalgo/core](https://github.com/dal-go/dalgo-js) — реализация на TypeScript, не привязанная к браузеру или серверу: иерархические ключи, типизированные коллекции, структурированные запросы, записи, сессии базы данных и запись только в транзакциях. Первый адаптер — для Firestore, он работает в браузере через модульный Web SDK Firebase. Подробнее: [DALgo для TypeScript](https://dalgo.io/ru/typescript/); как это устроено и чем отличается от Prisma, Drizzle, TypeORM и Kysely — в статье на английском [Database abstraction layer for TypeScript: @dalgo/core](https://dalgo.io/articles/typescript-database-abstraction/).

### Работает ли DALgo с Firestore?

Да. В Go адаптер `dalgo2firestore` подключает DALgo к Cloud Firestore. В статье [Firestore in Go: CRUD and transactions with DALgo](https://dalgo.io/articles/go-firestore-tutorial/) (англ.) документ создаётся, читается, изменяется и удаляется, выполняется транзакция чтения и записи, а те же функции в тестах работают на адаптере в памяти.

### Можно ли перевести сервис на Go с PostgreSQL на Firestore, не переписывая бизнес-код?

Да, для операций с записями, которые реализуют оба адаптера. Пишите предметный код против `dal.DB`, в `main` открывайте `dalgo2postgres` или `dalgo2firestore`, а в тестах используйте `dalgo2memory`. Разбор — в статье [Switching between PostgreSQL and Firestore in Go without rewriting business code](https://dalgo.io/articles/switch-postgres-to-firestore/) (англ.): репозиторий пользователей, что остаётся общим и чем хранилища всё же различаются (схема, соединения, транзакции).

### Когда DALgo не нужен?

DALgo оправдан, когда один и тот же код предметной области должен работать с несколькими хранилищами, включая тестовую замену. Он не подходит, когда сам язык запросов движка и есть продукт. Случаи перечислены в статье [When to use DALgo, and when not to](https://dalgo.io/articles/when-to-use-dalgo/) (англ.).

### Что такое TugQL?

TugQL — читаемый формат YAML для структурированных запросов DALgo. Его реализация на Go — пакет `tugql` в основном модуле, он сериализует `dal.StructuredQuery`. Подробнее: [TugQL](https://dalgo.io/tugql/) (англ.).

### Кто поддерживает DALgo?

DALgo разрабатывают участники DALgo в организации [dal-go](https://github.com/dal-go) на GitHub; как внести вклад, описано в [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/dal-go/dalgo/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md). DALgo служит слоем доступа к данным в инструментах разработки DataTug, а сервисы Sneat на Go тоже зависят от этого модуля. Подробнее: [Технологии DALgo](https://dalgo.io/ru/about/tech-stack/).

## Adapter catalogue

- [dalgo](https://github.com/dal-go/dalgo): Go module and the main DALgo implementation.
- [dalgo-js](https://github.com/dal-go/dalgo-js): TypeScript package @dalgo/core.
- [dalgo-http-adapters](https://github.com/dal-go/dalgo-http-adapters): Qualification matrix and catalog for DALgo TypeScript HTTP data adapters.
- [dalgo2memory](https://github.com/dal-go/dalgo/tree/main/adapters/dalgo2memory): In-memory adapter shipped in the core module — the default store for tests, examples, and local development. Runs most structured-query features end to end.
- [dalgo2fs](https://github.com/dal-go/dalgo/tree/main/adapters/dalgo2fs): Filesystem metadata exposed as DALgo records. Point reads only; structured queries, writes and transactions are not supported.
- [dalgo2sql](https://github.com/dal-go/dalgo2sql): Adapter for the standard database/sql — any compliant driver.
- [dalgo2sqlite](https://github.com/dal-go/dalgo2sqlite): SQLite-specific driver: schema, DDL, concurrency-aware operations on top of dalgo2sql.
- [dalgo2postgres](https://github.com/dal-go/dalgo2postgres): PostgreSQL-specific driver on top of dalgo2sql: forces the postgres dialect, introspects catalogs and applies Postgres DDL.
- [dalgo2mysql](https://github.com/dal-go/dalgo2mysql): MySQL-specific driver on top of dalgo2sql: schema introspection and MySQL DDL. CI runs the conformance suite against MySQL 8.
- [dalgo2ingitdb](https://github.com/ingitdb/dalgo2ingitdb): Adapter for inGitDB — a Git-native database with branchable, mergeable data. Reads and writes; a transaction can be committed to Git. Lives in the inGitDB organization.
- [dalgo2openvaultdb](https://github.com/dal-go/dalgo2openvaultdb): Adapter for OpenVaultDB through its ovdb serve HTTP API: reads and transactional writes.
- [dalgo2firestore](https://github.com/dal-go/dalgo2firestore): For Google Cloud Firestore — a globally distributed NoSQL document database.
- [dalgo2http](https://github.com/dal-go/dalgo2http): Declarative HTTP endpoints — JSON, plus named XML and CSV resources — exposed as DALgo collections. Read-only by design.
- [dalgo2files](https://github.com/dal-go/dalgo2files): JSON files, read-only
- [dalgo2logs](https://github.com/dal-go/dalgo2logs): log files, read-only
- [dalgo2mssql](https://github.com/dal-go/dalgo2mssql): SQL Server query dialect
- [dalgo2oracle](https://github.com/dal-go/dalgo2oracle): Oracle query dialect
- [dalgo2duckdb](https://github.com/dal-go/dalgo2duckdb): DuckDB, no schema introspection or DDL yet
- [dalgo2libsql](https://github.com/dal-go/dalgo2libsql): libSQL / Turso, read-only
- [dalgo2postgrest](https://github.com/dal-go/dalgo2postgrest): PostgREST, read-only
- [dalgo2mongodb](https://github.com/dal-go/dalgo2mongodb): MongoDB, read-only
- [dalgo2couchdb](https://github.com/dal-go/dalgo2couchdb): CouchDB, read-only
- [dalgo2redis](https://github.com/dal-go/dalgo2redis): Redis, read commands only
- [dalgo2typesense](https://github.com/dal-go/dalgo2typesense): Typesense, read-only
- [dalgo2bigquery](https://github.com/dal-go/dalgo2bigquery): BigQuery, read-only
- [dalgo2d1](https://github.com/dal-go/dalgo2d1): Cloudflare D1, read-only
- [dalgo2namecheap](https://github.com/dal-go/dalgo2namecheap): Namecheap domains and DNS, reads and writes

## Articles

- [Database abstraction layer for TypeScript: @dalgo/core](https://dalgo.io/articles/typescript-database-abstraction/): 2026-11-27. TypeScript database abstraction layer explained: how @dalgo/core models records, queries, and transactions, and where Prisma or Drizzle fit better. What a database abstraction layer is in TypeScript, how @dalgo/core models records, queries, and transactions for browser and server code, a type-checked example, and an honest comparison with Prisma, Drizzle ORM, TypeORM, and Kysely.
- [Go ORM and data-access libraries compared (2026)](https://dalgo.io/articles/go-orm-comparison-2026/): 2026-11-24. A 2026 golang ORM comparison of GORM, ent, bun, sqlc, sqlx, database/sql, and DALgo: what each is, how it works, and when to choose it. A side-by-side of the main Go data-access libraries in 2026: full ORMs, SQL-first tools, and a database abstraction layer that also spans non-SQL stores. Facts come from each project's official docs; there are no benchmarks.
- [Switching between PostgreSQL and Firestore in Go without rewriting business code](https://dalgo.io/articles/switch-postgres-to-firestore/): 2026-11-23. Switch Postgres to Firestore in Go without rewriting business code, using DALgo adapters for PostgreSQL, Cloud Firestore, and in-memory tests. Write a small users repository once against dal.DB, then open it on PostgreSQL, Cloud Firestore, or DALgo's in-memory adapter. This page shows what those calls share, what still differs, and how to copy records through the same interface.
- [Firestore in Go: CRUD and transactions with DALgo](https://dalgo.io/articles/go-firestore-tutorial/): 2026-11-16. Golang Firestore tutorial: Firestore Go CRUD and Firestore transactions in Go with DALgo, tested on the Firestore emulator and an in-memory stand-in. Connect to Cloud Firestore from Go through DALgo's dalgo2firestore adapter, then create, read, update and delete a document and run a read-write transaction. The same functions run on an in-memory adapter in unit tests.
- [DALgo vs GORM: a gorm alternative](https://dalgo.io/articles/dalgo-vs-gorm/): 2026-11-09. dalgo vs gorm: a gorm alternative and golang orm alternative for services that swap stores, and where GORM's relational model is the better fit. GORM is a full-featured object-relational mapper for the relational databases its guide names. DALgo is a database abstraction layer for the same record calls on SQL and on other stores, including memory and Firestore.
- [Database abstraction layer in Go: what it is and when you need one](https://dalgo.io/articles/go-database-abstraction-layer/): 2026-11-07. A Go database abstraction for services that swap stores, and how DALgo compares with database/sql, sqlx, GORM, ent, and sqlc. A database abstraction layer lets Go domain code talk to records, queries, and transactions while the storage backend stays replaceable. This is the definition, a compilable DALgo example, and a fair look at the usual alternatives.
- [Repository pattern in Go with a swappable storage backend](https://dalgo.io/articles/go-repository-pattern/): 2026-11-07. The Go repository pattern with a swappable backend: a golang repository pattern on DALgo, using memory in tests and SQL or Firestore in production. A Go repository is a small interface around storage. With DALgo behind it, the same repository type can be constructed on the in-memory adapter, SQLite, Postgres, or Firestore.
- [Why use DALgo](https://dalgo.io/articles/why-use-dalgo/): 2026-10-27. What DALgo gives Go and TypeScript applications — one record, query, and transaction API across real adapters — and the limits it refuses to hide. DALgo keeps domain code on one record, query, and transaction API while the storage backend stays replaceable. This is the case for it, grounded in the modules and the projects that already sit on that seam.
- [When to use DALgo, and when not to](https://dalgo.io/articles/when-to-use-dalgo/): 2026-10-27. An honest guide to the situations where DALgo is a good fit, and the situations where a database driver, SQL, or another tool should stay in charge. DALgo earns its place when the same domain code must run against more than one store, including a test double. It is the wrong tool when the engine's own language is the product.

## Adapter pages

- [SQLite in Go with DALgo: the dalgo2sqlite adapter](https://dalgo.io/adapters/dalgo2sqlite/): 2026-11-25. Golang SQLite with DALgo: the dalgo2sqlite adapter opens a SQLite file or memory DB in Go, and gives records, queries, transactions, and schema through dal.DB. dalgo2sqlite is the SQLite-specific DALgo driver for Go. It opens a file or an in-memory database with the pure-Go modernc.org/sqlite driver, wraps dalgo2sql to provide dal.DB, and adds SQLite schema introspection, DDL, and a single-writer concurrency hint.
- [MongoDB in Go with DALgo: the dalgo2mongodb adapter](https://dalgo.io/adapters/dalgo2mongodb/): 2026-11-26. Golang MongoDB with DALgo: the read-only dalgo2mongodb adapter opens a MongoDB URI in Go and runs point reads and bounded structured queries through dal.DB. dalgo2mongodb is the read-only MongoDB adapter for DALgo in Go. It opens a MongoDB database URI with the official Go driver and supports Get, GetMulti, Exists, and bounded structured queries; writes return dal.ErrNotSupported.
